ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: friends abroad
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Win a faction over until they count as allies: someone to trade with, and someone who answers when you call for help.

plain.li: Everyone out there is either selling us something or shooting at us. I'd like at least one of them to do neither.
Gifts, a few favors, a caravan or two. In a month someone out there could owe us. That's worth more than walls.
[afterraid] We held them off alone. Next time I'd like someone to call.
[small] There are a handful of us and a whole planet of them. We need friends.

warm.li: I keep thinking about the traders who came through. They had families too. Let's be good neighbors.
Nobody should have to face this world alone. Not even a colony.

blunt.li: We need allies. Not because I like people. Because people with guns are useful.
Pick a faction. Send them silver until they like us. It works on everyone else.

cheerful.li: Pen pals! But with guns, and caravans, and maybe a party once a year!
Imagine a whole faction who's happy to see us! I'll bake something. Well, someone will.

gloomy.li: One day something will come that we can't stop alone. I'd like there to be someone who'd notice.
If we die out here, nobody would even know. I'd like someone to know.

cold.li: Allies send soldiers we don't have to feed between raids. That's the cheapest army there is.
Goodwill is a currency. We should hold some.

plain.li: They call us friends now. Let's keep it that way.
Somewhere out there, someone would come if we called. That's new.

warm.li: We have friends. Real ones. I could cry, but I'll wave at the next caravan instead.

blunt.li: Good. Now we've got someone to borrow soldiers from.

cheerful.li: Allies! Actual allies! Someone send them a fruitcake!

gloomy.li: Allies. For now. People change their minds. Still, better than nothing.

cold.li: Alliance secured. Worth more than a turret line, and cheaper to maintain.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the finer things
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Make two new things of excellent quality or better: a chair, a sculpture, a coat, a gun. Proof that the colony can do more than survive.

plain.li: Everything we own was made in a hurry. I'd like a couple of things that weren't.
We're past sticks and string. Let's make something we're proud of.
[poor] We can't afford much. We can afford to do it well.
[tribal|medieval] Our grandparents' grandparents made things that lasted. We can too.

warm.li: I want to make something lovely for this place. Something people stop and touch on their way past.

blunt.li: I'm sick of chairs that wobble. Give me time and good material and I'll stop complaining.
Our stuff is ugly. Fix it or stop looking at it.

cheerful.li: Pretty things! Useful pretty things! Let's fill the place with them!

gloomy.li: Long after we're gone, someone will find whatever we leave behind. Let's leave something good.

cold.li: Higher quality means better stats and better trade value. Excellent work sells for far more than its materials.

plain.li: Look at the grain on that. Nobody made that in a hurry.

warm.li: People keep stopping to run their hands over it. That was the point.

cheerful.li: It's beautiful! I want to hug it! I won't. Probably.

cold.li: Two excellent pieces. The colony is measurably better made.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a masterwork
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Make a new masterwork: the best thing the colony has ever made. It takes a skilled hand, good material, and a bit of luck. An inspired crafter helps.

plain.li: I think I've got one great thing in me. I'd like the time to find out.
Somebody here is good enough to make a masterwork. Let's give them the bench and get out of the way.
[skill:Artistic] There's a sculpture I keep seeing when I close my eyes. I need to get it out.

warm.li: I want to make something for all of you. Something that says we were here, and we were together.

blunt.li: I'm the best crafter on this rock and nothing I've made proves it. Let's fix that.

cheerful.li: A masterwork! A real one! People will write songs about it! Small songs. In this colony.

gloomy.li: Everything we build burns eventually. I'd like to make one thing that's worth crying over.

cold.li: A masterwork is worth several times the same item at normal quality. It's the best return on materials we'll get.
[trait:Greedy] One masterwork is worth a whole caravan of normal goods. I've done the math.

plain.li: That's it. That's the one. Everybody come and look.

warm.li: It's for all of us. Everyone helped, even if they only cooked dinner.

blunt.li: Told you. Now nobody touch it with dirty hands.

cheerful.li: A MASTERWORK! In our colony! Made by us! I need to sit down.

gloomy.li: It's perfect. I'll never make anything this good again. That's fine. I made this one.

cold.li: Masterwork confirmed. Its value alone covers the materials many times over.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the long night
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Stack 300 wood before winter: fuel for the fires, the stoves and the heaters, so the cold doesn't decide who lives.

plain.li: The fires eat wood faster than we cut it. When the snow comes we'll be burning the furniture.
Winter's coming, and I can count the logs in the stockpile on my fingers. Let's cut.
[fall] The leaves are going. In a few weeks so are the trees we can reach. Cut now.
[tribal] The old ones say a woodpile should be taller than the tallest of us. Ours isn't.

warm.li: I don't want anyone shivering in bed this winter. Let's fill the woodpile while we can.

blunt.li: No wood, no fire. No fire, no us. Grab an axe.

cheerful.li: A big, beautiful woodpile! Crackling fires! Hot soup! Everyone grab an axe, it'll be fun!

gloomy.li: Last winter I dreamed I was frozen to my bed. I'd rather not find out if it was a prophecy.
[winter] We're already in it, and the pile's already low. This is how colonies end.

cold.li: Heating consumes fuel at a fixed rate. Our stock won't last the cold months. Cut more now, or lose people later.

plain.li: That's a woodpile. Let the snow come.

warm.li: Everyone will sleep warm. That's all I wanted.

cheerful.li: Look at it! It's taller than me! We're going to be so toasty!

gloomy.li: Enough to last the winter. If the winter plays fair.

cold.li: Fuel reserves sufficient. Heating is no longer a limiting factor.
